summary: Tested the new price parser, deal-site link handling, the poller/cron, manual deal prices, and the bulk convert UI. All 18 pytest tests pass. Unit tests: engine.extract_prices returns the expected price/MRP for all 7 sample texts (Haier 45240/None, Armani 4979, Scooter 38950/52000, Gold 14359, Offer Price 1279/4599, Mokobara None, Instamart 328). is_deal_site is correct for the sample URLs. GET /api/deals: no deal has mrp <= price*1.03. 'Triple Loot Offers' has price 45240 and mrp 101990. The Armani deal has price 4979. No deal is marked converted while its clean_url is a deal site. POST /api/convert/bulk with the Armani post returns price 4979, mrp 19995, store_price 8399 and a fkrt.site link. POST /api/convert with the desidime URL returns cleaned=https://www.biba.in/us (no desidime), and it is not converted. POST /api/cron/fetch: 401 without auth, 200 {accepted:true} with the Bearer secret. last_scan_at changed within 150s. A manual deal (499/999) kept its prices after enrich and was then deleted. UI /admin Convert Links: the card shows ₹4,979, ₹19,995 struck through, 'store now ₹8,399 (before offers)' (bulk-store-price-0), and 'Converted to your Sankmo link'. Copy details + link gives 'Deal Price: ₹4,979 / MRP: ₹19,995 / 75% OFF'. The image proxy returns 200. Home page cards: Triple Loot ₹45,240 vs ₹1,01,990. The ₹8,443 card no longer shows the ₹8,445 MRP. Mokobara shows 'Price on store'.

minor.issue: For the desidime link (biba.in, Sankmo timeout) error is '' (empty string) instead of a readable message. The single convert endpoint uses str(e) without the 'Sankmo bot timed out' fallback that convert_bulk has.

The desidime link resolved to https://www.biba.in/us. That looks like a geo redirect from the US server, not the real product/sale page. Indian users may land on the wrong store region. Consider stopping at the first store-domain URL instead of following redirects to the end.

action_items: Optional: in POST /api/convert, use the same empty-error fallback as convert_bulk ('Sankmo bot timed out')
Optional: avoid following store geo redirects (biba.in -> /us) when resolving deal-site links
critical_code_review_comments: The MRP cutoff is 1.02 in engine.extract_prices but 1.03 in server enrich/apply_post_price. They should match.
reprice_all runs only once, gated by prices_v2. Deals ingested before the fix and re-ingested later are fine.
fix_deal_site_links runs on every startup. Each unresolved deal-site deal makes an HTTP call (and possibly a bot conversion) on every restart. Mark deals already tried.
server.py is 1059 lines. It should be split into modules (deals, convert, cron, enrich).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ manual deal was created and deleted. Bulk converts added db.links docs. Telegram was not logged out.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: pytest tests/test_iteration16_prices_dealsites.py (about 100s; includes a 150s max wait for the poller). pytest.ini adds xdist (-n). Use '-n 0' to see print output. Stats at test time: total 71 deals, 16 sources.
